characters.name: Captain Nathan Bridger
characters.description: Badass Bookworm: He is the designer of the submarines he leads into exploration and battle. Dark and Troubled Past: He became a hermit with his wife after his son died in action. Then she died to. Living Legend: The secondReasonable Authority Figureis embarrassed at the very idea of arresting a legend like him.

characters.name: Commander Jonathan Ford
characters.description: Quickly-Demoted Leader: He is acting captain at the start but agrees with the admiral to fake beingThe Neidermeyerto help provoke the more qualified Bridger to come out of retirement and take over while Ford becomes second in command. The Un-Favorite: His father likes his brother better for not running away from their sea farm like Ford did.

characters.name: Lt. Tim O'Neil
characters.description: Badass Bookworm: He's a bespectacled, scholarly guy who fights an alien predator in one episode and steals a boat to race through dangerous territory and help his online girlfriend defect from the Chaodai while taking out her pursuers with a booby trap. Religious Scientist: He's an expert in languages, communications systems, and understanding evolution and is a religious man who nonetheless hopes aliens exist despite the possible theological contradictions.

characters.name: Dr. Wendy Smith
characters.description: Hospital Hottie: She's a doctor of multiple disciplines and sometimes wears tank tops, nice skirts, or partially unzipped wetsuits. Psychic Powers: She can read minds since childhood, although she tries not to.

characters.name: Dagwood
characters.description: Almighty Janitor: He is a literal janitor on the ship despite being aSuper-Soldierprototype. Bald Head of Toughness: He has super strength and no hair. Meaningful Name: He named himself as a more normal sounding play on the word "Daggers", a nickname for G.E.L.Fs like him.

characters.name: Kristin Westphalen
characters.description: Family Versus Career: She suggests she is estranged from her ex-husband and children due to her service and sees Bridger and Lucas as surrogates. Renaissance Man: She is a linguistSuper Doc(biochemistry is one of her specialities) and chess player.

characters.name: Lucas Wolenczak
characters.description: Teen Genius: He is the youngest of the heroes and one of the smartest even considering the completion in brains among the crew, even inventing Darwin's translator.

characters.name: James Brody
characters.description: Big Guy Fatality Syndrome: Brody is the crewman most at home in field actions for most of seasons 2 and 3 and doesn’t survive the later season. Unknown Relative: He has a son whose mother never told him she was pregnant.

characters.name: Benjamin Krieg
characters.description: High Hopes, Zero Talent: He wants to be a captain but is morale and supply officer. Mr. Vice Guy: Krieg is a greedy, flirty prankster but still a competent and loyal subordinate.

characters.name: Captain Oliver Hudson
characters.description: Ascended Fanboy: He has spent a decade looking for the missingSeaQuestand hoping to command her himself one day and gets his wish when Bridger is unavailable. Jerkass to One: He is an excellent mentor to most of the core crew but is hard on O’Neil.

characters.name: Tony Piccolo
characters.description: Bruiser with a Soft Center: He isTrading Bars for Stripesand his experiments gills mean he is sent into the field for some tough stuff, but he enjoys music and buddying around with the others. "L" Is for "Dyslexia": He is illiterate and only earns to read studying with Henderson in season 3.

characters.name: Lonnie Henderson
characters.description: Cute Bruiser: She insists on bringing aSecurity BlanketTeddy on board, teaches Piccolo to read, and is constantly protective of kids but can hold her own on a fight or other near-death experience now and then.

characters.name: Miguel Ortiz
characters.description: Hidden Depths: He sometimes seems like the straight man of the command crew but also has a keen interest in Atlantis. Long-Haired Pretty Boy: Downplayed, but he is one of the youngest and most handsome crew members and has wavy dark hair that goes down a bit past his chin.

characters.name: Darwin the Dolphin
characters.description: Action Pet: He is a dolphin companion of Bridger who, thanks to a translator device and scuba tank, can act as a spotter for undersea fights and other such duties.

characters.name: Katherine Hitchcock
characters.description: Defiant Captive: She usesExact Wordsto unnerve a hostage taker and ultimately lure him to his death in one episode. Wrench Wench: She isThe Engineerof the ship and builder of theStingerminisub.

characters.name: Manilow Crocker
characters.description: Manly Facial Hair: He is the main fighter on away missions and the only main character across all three seasons with a beard.

characters.name: J.J. Fredericks
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname: Some of the people closest to her call her Freddie. Broken Ace: She's a respected subfighter pilot who is reluctant to re-enter the cockpit after nearly drowning in a training accident. Manchurian Agent: There is an implant in her head to make her assasinate the secretary general, but the others get her to successfully fight back against it.
